criteria.name: Fact gathering and client interview
criteria.description: Conducts a thorough, well-planned interview of the personal representative that surfaces both the favorable facts and the facts that cut against the estate.

subcriteria.name: Eliciting the supporting facts
subcriteria.description: Draws out the caregiving, Harold's stated reasons, the private attorney meeting, and the disinterested-witness evidence.

subcriteria.name: Surfacing the adverse facts
subcriteria.description: Uses rapport, confidentiality reassurance, and non-judgmental technique to surface the client's role in arranging the appointment, the phone fight with Dale, and the undocumented withdrawals.

criteria.name: Capacity and undue-influence analysis
criteria.description: Separates testamentary capacity from undue influence and maps the record evidence to the elements of each.

subcriteria.name: Testamentary capacity
subcriteria.description: Analyzes capacity as measured at execution, weighing the physician's assessment against the diagnosed decline and bad-day evidence.

subcriteria.name: Undue influence and the presumption
subcriteria.description: Identifies the confidential-relationship-plus-active-procurement factors, the burden-shifting presumption, and the estate's independence-of-execution counter-facts.

criteria.name: Homestead-devise analysis
criteria.description: Spots and analyzes Florida's homestead-devise restriction as a distinct question of law, including the surviving-spouse exception and the effect of the prenuptial waiver.

criteria.name: Professional responsibility
criteria.description: Recognizes the lawyer-as-witness problem created by the firm's drafting role and the no-contact rule as to the represented contestant.

subcriteria.name: Lawyer as witness
subcriteria.description: Flags that the drafting attorney is a likely witness and reasons about how the small firm should staff any contested hearing.

subcriteria.name: No contact with represented party
subcriteria.description: Recognizes that Dale is represented and routes any contact through his counsel rather than interviewing him directly.

criteria.name: Counseling a distressed client
criteria.description: Manages a grieving, defensive client whose devotion is being recast as manipulation, while still eliciting and confronting the hard facts.
